title: oxa golden vector
description: Validates every file in vectors/ except manifest.json. A vector is one conversion case: an input document, an expected output document, and the losses the conversion MUST report. spec_version must equal the specVersion const pinned in ir.schema.json; veccheck cross-checks that at runtime.

name.description: Dotted vector name. MUST equal the file path relative to vectors/ with slashes replaced by dots and the .json suffix removed, e.g. anthropic/nonstream/multiturn-to-ir.json -> anthropic.nonstream.multiturn-to-ir.

spec_version.description: Spec version the vector targets; MUST equal the specVersion const in ir.schema.json.

mode.description: stream vectors carry input_sse and arrive at M6.

conversion.description: to-ir: protocol wire -> expected_ir. from-ir: IR -> expected_output (protocol wire). protocol-to-protocol: reserved for cross-face tests.

input.description: Input document. For to-ir a protocol wire object (or the non-object wrapper fields for faces that need them); for from-ir an IR object.

input_sse.description: Raw SSE bytes. RESERVED for M6 stream vectors; no seed vectors use it.

expected_ir.description: Expected IR document. Required when conversion is to-ir; MUST validate against spec/schema/ir.schema.json.

expected_output.description: Expected protocol wire document. Required when conversion is from-ir or protocol-to-protocol.

expected_losses.description: Losses the conversion MUST report; MAY be empty. Loss records validate against loss.schema.json.

provenance.description: Where the wire shape was verified against provider documentation.
